add.why: the barge's hold door in its waist, where Black Marsh & Valenwood stands it on the ship (record hook: the barge's hold locks from outside and a new gang waits in it; main quest 1 opens in the hold), into a copy of the ship's own furnished hold

the stone hut's door, a Raven Rock door in the frame Baan Malur gives it, into a copy of that house's own room (its stone house part only, by a cut): where the gang-master sleeps, keeps his strongbox and lets a guest sleep on the bench (record: free-bed, treasure)

01dock3to4.name: Barge Hold
01dock3to4.why: the work barge's hold, where the new gang sleeps locked in (main quest 1 opens here; record hook)

AshgateHut.name: Gang-Master's Hut
AshgateHut.why: the old road post's stone hut where Dralin Uveran the gang-master sleeps and keeps his strongbox (record look and hook)
